stage: A (audit) + B (spec) + C3 (Баатар class armour, armour progression, ActivePlaytime)

classArmor.note: Баатар only: 4 pieces × 6 tiers, soulbound, fixed rarity per tier, stat budget fitted to the simulator's generic proxy; granted and worn at class pick (and on join for existing Баатар characters), regenerated in place with the same UUIDs on armour level / tier changes; recover + duplicate removal; kept on death; guarded by SoulboundGuard. Other 4 classes: no definitions yet

armorLevel.note: armour XP from validated active minutes (0.6), kills 0.2/1/3, quest 20, discovery 15, dungeon clear 25 × repeat fatigue; capped at the player level, ×2 catch-up; live-tested. The desk XP values still need measuring on humans (ACTIVE_PLAYTIME_SPEC). QUEST grants count as a chapter (daily tasks too) and every DISCOVERY as a region (landmarks are not told apart)

armorTier.note: gates (armour level, dungeon cleared, coins, band materials, Ascension for T6) enforced; T2 (Говийн Булш) and T3 (Мөсөн Оргил) are reachable in today's content; T4–T6 dungeons (khar_khot, burkhan_aguy, tengeriin_ordon) and Ascension are not in the game yet, so T4+ is blocked. Bought by command, not yet at the smith NPC

armorSetBonuses.note: Баатар 2-piece max health / 4-piece damage reduction, growing per tier

armorVisuals.note: procedural 64×32 placeholder layers (helmet painted on the head layer); final art and 3D helmet models are Stage C4; MANUAL_QA_REQUIRED in a real client

activePlaytime.note: 1-minute windows, strong/two-family rule, soul exclusion, auto-clicker (>120 identical intervals ±10 ms), AFK mob farm (3rd minute of damage-in), away after 15 min, area fatigue (armour XP only), passive movement (rail, boat, glide, water current) excluded; per-category minutes in the profile (V13); feeds armour XP and wound healing. Live: 2 combat minutes counted, 2+ AFK minutes counted 0. Not done: yaw/pitch macro pattern, the EXP part of area fatigue (a balance change), session totals to analytics, the 'away' TAB marker

statPipeline.note: armour stats already flow into SkillBuild; reuse

persistence.note: round trip and refuse-to-load-broken-data verified on PostgreSQL; MySQL migration written, not run here

clientQa.note: worn look of the six tiers, tooltip, equip sounds

armorEnhancement.note: +2 % per step through the stat pipeline (items unchanged, so the validator stays exact); tempering not implemented

spec.status: IMPLEMENTED for Баатар (Stage C3); other classes SPEC
